question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**fatalities**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the consequences of earthquakes, including injuries and deaths caused by falling debris and structures.
 
• The appropriate noun should refer to deaths or the loss of life, as this matches the context of the sentence.
 
• "Fatalities" fits perfectly, as it refers to deaths, particularly in disasters such as earthquakes.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Survival: **"Survival" refers to continuing existence, which does not match the focus on the negative outcomes of earthquakes like deaths.
 
• **Durability: **"Durability" refers to the ability to withstand wear or damage, which is not relevant to describing the fatalities from an earthquake.
 
• **Viability: **"Viability" refers to the ability to live or work successfully, which is unrelated to deaths or destruction caused by earthquakes.
